title: Coherent continuous realizations of the raw finite coefficient diagram
statement:
Fix $k=\overline{\mathbf F}_q$, a prime $\ell\ne\operatorname{char}k$, and $\Omega=\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$ [def-weil-finite-field-fiber]. Let $T$ be a separated finite-type $k$-scheme. On its small pro-etale site [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site], for each finite $E\subset\Omega$ put $B_{E,T}=\varprojlim_{n\ge1}(\mathcal O_E/\varpi_E^n)_T$ [def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients], $E_T=B_{E,T}[1/\varpi_E]$, and $R_T=p_T^*\underline\Omega$, where $\underline\Omega(S)$ consists of continuous functions on a profinite set $S$ valued in one finite subextension [sk-def-sfb-qlbar-condensed, sk-prop-sfb-qlbar-colimit-x]. Write $\mathcal C_E(T)=D^b_c(T,E)$ for the raw rationalization of derived-complete integral constructible complexes, with its specified completed finite scalar transitions $S_{F/E}$ [def-weil-rationalization-karoubi]. Write $\mathcal C_T$ for the common-stage pair category of these $\mathcal C_E(T)$, with Hom groups the directed colimits over common finite fields [def-weil-algebraically-closed-coefficients]. For $A=E_T,R_T$, let $\mathcal D_T(A)$ be the full subcategory of $D(\operatorname{Mod}(A))$ [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category, def-weil-abstract-derived-category] of bounded objects whose cohomology sheaves have a finite locally closed stratification on each stratum of which they are pro-etale locally finite free over $A$.

The scheme $T$ is noetherian, finite-dimensional and quasi-compact quasi-separated, and $\ell$ is invertible on $T$. The integral category used in $\mathcal C_E(T)$ and the integral category of [def-weil-pbc-bounded-constructible-complete] are the same full subcategory of $D(B_{E,T})$, with the same morphisms and reductions. Their raw rationalizations therefore agree without Karoubi completion. The two descriptions of bounded constructibility, stratified local finite presentation [sk-def-sfb-bounded-constructible] and the locally finite free description of $\mathcal D_T(A)$, agree for $A=E_T,R_T$.

For every finite $E$, derived scalar extension gives an exact $E$-linear equivalence $J_{E,T}:\mathcal C_E(T)\simeq\mathcal D_T(E_T)$ with object formula $E_T\otimes^L_{B_{E,T}}K$ on an integral representative. For $E\subset F$, let $\chi_{F/E,K}$ be the specified quotient-tower comparison of [lem-weil-finite-free-completed-scalar-comparison]. Its inverse followed by balanced tensor multiplication defines natural scalar isomorphisms
$$j_{F/E,K}:J_{F,T}(S_{F/E}K)\xrightarrow{\sim}F_T\otimes^L_{E_T}J_{E,T}K.$$
On every rational arrow $u\otimes a$ these identify both routes with scalar extension of $u$ multiplied by the image of $a$. These $j$ intertwine the actual identity and composition comparisons of $S$, not arbitrary replacements: for $E\subset F\subset G$ the direct and successive comparisons agree under the balanced associator, normalized by $g\otimes(f\otimes(e\otimes x))\mapsto gfe\otimes x$; the identity uses $1\otimes x\mapsto x$. The same equations hold after further scalar extension to $R_T$. Integral theta normalization uses the completed-coefficient square and the equality of the two maps into the common single derived tensor after applying the published integral scalar comparison; it does not identify distinct tensor-source presentations by heterogeneous equality.

proof.text: Finite type over Spec k gives local Noetherianity and compactness, hence IsNoetherian; exists_topologicalKrullDim_le gives a natural-number dimension bound and separatedness gives quasi-separatedness. The finite base field has characteristic p from its cardinality p^a; its algebraic closure has the same characteristic. Since ell differs from p and is prime it is a unit in k, and mapping through global sections and stalk germs makes it a unit in all stalks.

RationalConeModels.bounded_model lifts its finite truncation tower, giving an integral object whose raw realization is the complex. Conversely, the realization constructible clause and its literal objects formula transport bounds and stratified finite freeness along the given isomorphism. Replace the lower bound by min(a,b) to order the interval. This constructs Core.

old_proof.text: The field $k$ is Noetherian: its only ideals are $0$ and $k$. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-finite-type-over-noetherian] to $T\to\operatorname{Spec}k$ and [lem-kun-dimension-finite-type] to obtain Noetherianity and finite dimension. The separated finite-type clause of [lem-weil-pbc-qcqs-over-affine] gives qcqs. Since $\ell$ is nonzero in $k$, its inverse in $k$ maps to an inverse in every local ring of $T$. These are exactly the scheme hypotheses needed below.

old_proof.text: Apply [lem-weil-pbc-integral-stratified-perfect-characterization] with $A=\mathcal O_E$ and $\varpi=\varpi_E$. Its last paragraph identifies both integral categories in the statement, including the compatible etale-origin witnesses, with the same full subcategory of $D(B_{E,T})$; its reductions use this same ring and the same quotient maps. Thus their objects and all derived morphisms coincide. By [def-weil-rationalization-karoubi], raw rationalization keeps those objects and replaces each Hom by $\operatorname{Hom}\otimes_{\mathcal O_E}E$, with composition and triangles induced from the integral category. Applying this identical construction to the identical full subcategories gives the same raw category, without adjoining retracts.

old_proof.text: Identify the pulled-back continuous $E$-ring with $E_T=B_{E,T}[1/\varpi_E]$ using [lem-weil-pbc-continuous-coefficients-immersion-restriction] and [lem-weil-pbc-continuous-coefficient-realizations]; the latter also identifies the maps induced by inclusions of coefficient rings. On each locally closed stratum apply [lem-weil-pbc-condensed-lfp-local-triviality] for $E_T$ and [lem-weil-pbc-condensed-qbar-lfp-local-triviality] for $R_T$. The strata have Noetherian underlying spaces because locally closed subspaces of a Noetherian space are Noetherian. Both cited statements turn a pro-etale local finite presentation into local finite freeness. Conversely a finite free module of rank $r$ is the cokernel of $0\to A^r$, giving a finite presentation. By [def-weil-pbc-internal-abelian-sheaf-module-equivalence], module objects over the ring object $A$ and sheaves of modules over its section-ring sheaf correspond with identical underlying abelian sheaves, sections and restrictions, so cokernel presentations, free modules and inverse images to strata match in the two descriptions. Applied to each cohomology sheaf, this is precisely the constructibility predicate of [sk-def-sfb-bounded-constructible], with the same bounded interval. The qbar theorem uses exactly finite-subextension-valued sections, so no full continuous or discrete algebraic-closure ring is substituted.

old_proof.text: Use [lem-weil-pbc-condensed-e-realization] for the field $k$ and scheme $T$. Its functor is an $E$-linear equivalence induced by derived scalar extension from $B_{E,T}$ to the continuous $E$-ring, and its statement identifies the target local-presentation and local-free predicates. The specified internal/sectionwise encoding of [def-weil-pbc-continuous-coefficient-module-encoding] is an equivalence on module categories preserving the regular module and finite sums; termwise it identifies the ambient derived categories and their cohomology. Steps 2 and 3 therefore identify the source and target of this equivalence with exactly $\mathcal C_E(T)$ and $\mathcal D_T(E_T)$. Its formula on an integral representative is $E_T\otimes^L_{B_{E,T}}K$. Exactness follows also directly from the derived scalar-extension functor of [lem-pur-derived-change-of-rings], so this gives the claimed exact $J_{E,T}$.

old_proof.text: For $E\subset F$, take exactly $\chi_{F/E,K}$ of [lem-weil-finite-free-completed-scalar-comparison]. The input $K$ is derived complete by step 2, so this natural map is invertible; the same cited statement makes its source derived complete over $B_{F,T}$, allowing the next comparison in a tower. Apply $F_T\otimes^L_{B_{F,T}}-$ to its inverse, then balanced tensor multiplication. This gives $J_{F,T}S_{F/E}K\cong F_T\otimes^L_{B_{E,T}}K\cong F_T\otimes^L_{E_T}J_{E,T}K$. The balancing is the coequalizer multiplication and inverse insertion of $1$ specified in [lem-sfb-internal-tensor-composition-unit-normalization]; [lem-pur-derived-change-of-rings] computes its derived version on K-flat representatives. The maps induced by field inclusions are those of step 3. Naturality of $\chi$ gives naturality for integral arrows. For a rational generator $u\otimes a$, [def-weil-rationalization-karoubi] sends it through $S$ to the integral scalar extension of $u$ multiplied by the image of $a$. Since tensor multiplication is linear over the final field ring, both routes give that same multiple of the scalar extension of $u$; additivity gives the assertion for all rational arrows.

old_proof.text:
Write $C_{F/E}=B_{F,T}\otimes^L_{B_{E,T}}-$ and $I_{F/E}$ for the specified completed transition. By step 5 both $K$ and $C_{F/E}K$ are derived complete. Put $A=I_{G/F}(\chi_{F/E,K})$ and $B=\chi_{G/F,C_{F/E}K}$. The equation of [lem-fix-scalar-completion-associator] reads $a^I_KAB=\chi_{G/E,K}a^C_K$, using the actual quotient cocones and quotient-system associators. All these maps are invertible, so multiplication by their inverses gives
$$\chi_{G/E,K}^{-1}a^I_K=a^C_KB^{-1}A^{-1}.$$
Apply $G_T\otimes^L_{B_{G,T}}-$ and insert the balanced multiplications from step 5. The left side is the direct $j_{G/E}$ following the actual completed associator; the right side is the successive $j_{F/E},j_{G/F}$ following the balanced associator, by naturality of $\chi_{G/F}$. This proves the required equality. At $E=F$, [lem-weil-finite-free-completed-scalar-comparison] identifies $\chi$ with the completeness map used in the unit clause of the associator theorem. Cancellation leaves $1\otimes x\mapsto x$. [lem-sfb-internal-tensor-composition-unit-normalization] fixes balanced multiplication, so the tower formula is $g\otimes(f\otimes(e\otimes x))\mapsto gfe\otimes x$. [lem-weil-pbc-condensed-flat-coefficient-calculus] supplies the field-ring unit and pentagon identities, also for $R_T$. The Hom formula of [def-weil-rationalization-karoubi] extends the equations to rational arrows by linearity. Applying the exact scalar functor $R_T\otimes^L_{G_T}-$ preserves composition, inverses and equality, giving the final asserted equations.
